Smooth Operator {{ .Chart.AppVersion }} installed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

1. Verify the controller is running:
   kubectl get pods -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} -l app.kubernetes.io/name={{ include "smooth-operator.name" . }}

2. CRDs registered:
   kubectl get crd chatsessions.smooth.smooth.k8s.io smoothactions.smooth.smooth.k8s.io

3. Apply a sample ChatSession:
   kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mbergo/smooth-operator/main/config/samples/smooth_v1_chatsession.yaml

4. Watch the operator process the session:
   kubectl get chatsessions -A -w

{{- if not .Values.operator.llmApiKeySecret }}

WARNING: operator.llmApiKeySecret is unset. The operator will start but LLM
inference will be disabled until a Secret containing LLM_API_KEY is referenced.
{{- end }}

{{- if not .Values.operator.gitTokenSecret }}

WARNING: operator.gitTokenSecret is unset. Pull request creation against
GitHub or GitLab will degrade gracefully (no PR opened).
{{- end }}
